title: Data Leak Checker
description: Find out if your email address or personal data has been exposed in a data breach. We use anonymous hashing to keep your search private.

hero.title: Exposed?

advice.title: Next Steps
advice.password_reset: Change your password immediately for all affected services.
advice.unique_pass: Use a unique, strong password for every account.
advice.manager: Use a password manager to keep track of your credentials.
